goal: Integration operator can durably preserve XianGuanJia order details and advance a stable cursor only after local persistence succeeds.
non_goals: Do not call a real XianGuanJia API, add a controller, scheduler, or admin page.
Do not implement third-party writes, product/shop/after-sale persistence, order conversion, or device allocation.
Do not place credentials, signatures, private recipient fields, or raw payloads in source, fixtures, logs, or responses.
expected_evidence: Focused parser, persistence, and cursor ordering tests
Maven module test output and no-write-path scan
unsafe_assumptions: The existing additive foundation migration is deployed before this code is enabled.
A later orchestration layer supplies only successful order-detail data and advances the cursor after a fully durable page.
stop_condition: Stop if the task would require a third-party write operation, an undocumented source field, a new schema decision, or files outside the scope lock.
